climb_profile.profile_type: Rolling 127-130 km road course with three moderate categorized climbs and no high-altitude summit

course_description.character: The current 2027 organizer profile shows a rolling Alto Minho loop from Viana do Castelo with three categorized climbs spread across the middle and final third: Pedras Finas (9.5km at 3.2%), Sapardos (2.5km at 5.5%), and 7 Caminhos (5.5km at 3.2%). The route graphic labels 127km, while the regulation advertises 130km. Intermediate markers include Vila de Punhe around km17.5, Ponte das Poldras around km80, and Vila Praia de Ancora around km109 before the return to Viana. Roads remain open to traffic under the Portuguese Highway Code.
course_description.signature_challenge: Pedras Finas (9.5km at 3.2%) is the longest sustained climb; Sapardos follows with the day's steepest published average at 5.5%.
suffering_zones: Pedras Finas (9.5km at 3.2%) — the longest climb, beginning around the approach to kilometre 50
Sapardos (2.5km at 5.5%) — the sharpest average gradient and highest labeled point at 323m
7 Caminhos (5.5km at 3.2%) — the final categorized climb, around kilometre 101
Open-road racing — the Highway Code remains in force and riders must account for normal traffic controls

logistics.lodging_strategy: Viana do Castelo is a mid-size coastal city with standard tourist accommodation.

history.origin_story: Launched 19 March 2023 by organizer Bikeservice as part of Viana do Castelo's year as European City of Sport, debuting with 131/84/62km routes through Viana do Castelo, Ponte de Lima, Paredes de Coura and Caminha, and drawing an estimated 1,700-2,000 riders in its first edition.
notable_moments: Reached its fourth edition in 2026 and is officially scheduled to return for a fifth edition on 14 March 2027
history.reputation: A young Alto Minho fondo with a strong, consistent debut-level turnout and a genuinely rolling-to-mountainous course for the region — its own published numbers, however, don't always agree with each other.

biased_opinion.verdict: Young, Scenic, Slightly Sloppy on Paperwork
biased_opinion.summary: Viana Granfondo returns for its fifth edition on 14 March 2027 with registration open and a clearly published competitive format. The current profile is more rolling than mountainous: Pedras Finas, Sapardos, and 7 Caminhos are all moderate categorized climbs, with the highest labeled point at only 323m. The organizer still has a paperwork problem. Its regulation advertises 130km while its own route graphic says 127km; Article 4 caps the field at 1,500 while a later closure rule and the box allocation run to 1,800; and the fee section carries one stale 2026 date inside an otherwise 2027 document.
strengths: Three documented categorized climbs create a useful rolling-course progression without alpine altitude
Competitive amateur format with electronic timing, category classifications, and team awards
Participant package includes solid and liquid aid, medical support, mechanical assistance, and a finisher meal
City start and finish in Viana do Castelo simplify race-morning logistics
weaknesses: The organizer's own 2027 sources disagree on the flagship distance: 130km in the regulation, 127km on the route graphic
The same regulation gives both a 1,500-rider cap and a later 1,800-rider registration/box limit
Open roads, not full closures — Highway Code traffic rules apply for the whole route
A March date means real weather risk (cold, wind, rain) on the Atlantic coast
biased_opinion.bottom_line: A legitimate early-season fondo with three manageable climbs, real competition, and a compact city start — but build pacing around a 127-130km range until the organizer resolves its own distance and field-size conflicts.

final_verdict.one_liner: A young Alto Minho fondo with three moderate climbs, real competition, and still-conflicting official numbers.
final_verdict.should_you_race: Yes, if you want an early-season European fondo with rolling terrain and chip-timed competition — prepare for 127-130km and confirm final organizer instructions before locking pacing or support plans.
final_verdict.alternatives: For a more established, better-documented Portuguese road fondo, compare against other Bikeservice Superprestigio rounds later in the same series calendar.

videos.title: Granfondo VIANA DO CASTELO | Aventura de Ciclismo no coração da cidade
videos.description:
VIANA GRANFONDO 🇵🇹

1700 ciclistas num Granfondo que teve uma pitada muito especial, largamos entre os 100 primeiros e pudemos sentir a emoção de andar no meio de um pelotão cheio de feras!

Um desafio à altura das belas paisagens que se encontram pelo caminho, cada obstáculo ultrapassado era premiado com uma vista de tirar o fôlego!

Três percursos de diferentes graus de dificuldade mas todos eles capazes de deixar belíssimas recordações. 

São eles: o Granfondo, com 131 km; o Mediofondo, com 84 km; e o Minifondo, com 62 km.

Os percursos, com partida e chegada à cidade de Viana do Castelo, passando por concelhos como Ponte de Lima, Paredes de Coura ou Caminha, oferecem paisagens únicas de mar e serra, assim como um riquíssimo património cultural de onde há a destacar, entre outros, o Templo do Sagrado Coração de Jesus, no monte de Santa Luzia, ou o Santuário de Nossa Senhora das Neves, em Caminha.

“Vamos conquistar o coração do Minho”

Um grande abraço para todos.
